root_cause: The exclusive 'No symptoms' checkbox includes data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms" alongside data-checkbox-exclusive, unlike the working 'Do not contact me' checkbox which has only data-checkbox-exclusive. This likely causes the NHSUK checkboxes module to treat the exclusive option as a regular group member rather than the exclusive control, preventing it from clearing other symptom checkboxes when selected.
repair_strategy: Remove the data-checkbox-exclusive-group attribute from the exclusive 'No symptoms' checkbox so only the symptom checkboxes carry the group marker, matching the pattern used by the working contact checkboxes.

edits.before: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms">
edits.after: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive>

expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can select 'No, I do not have any of these symptoms' and have any previously selected symptom checkboxes automatically cleared, meeting exclusive choice behavior and preserving form data integrity.
functional_risks: If the module relies on the exclusive checkbox having the group attribute for group identification, this could break the behavior.
Ensure the change does not affect visual styling or form validation.
verification_requirements: Verify that selecting the exclusive option via mouse or keyboard clears any previously selected symptom checkboxes.
Verify that selecting a symptom after the exclusive option clears the exclusive option.
Confirm that form submission reflects the correct values for symptoms[none] and symptom checkboxes.
Ensure the contact checkboxes exclusive behavior remains unchanged.
